计算机.name: Computers
计算机.summary: Customers like the high cost-performance ratio, attractive design, and solid build quality across various laptops in the category. However, the main problems are difficulties with operating system installations, severe heating issues, and noisy disk drives.

fix_first.issue: Difficulty installing alternative operating systems like XP and missing or hard-to-find drivers
fix_first.evidence: 24 negative mentions + "装xp系统很麻烦，驱动难找，不全"
fix_first.action: Provide clear online guides and comprehensive driver download bundles for popular OS alternatives on the product pages.

fix_first.issue: High heat generation and fan noise or hard drive noise
fix_first.evidence: 28 negative mentions + "硬盘声音太响了, 和以前的老光驱里读盘得声音差不多."
fix_first.action: Coordinate with hardware manufacturers to review thermal design and component noise levels in future batches.

fix_first.issue: Discrepancies in product listings regarding specifications and included accessories
fix_first.evidence: 10 negative mentions + "明明装箱清单里有鼠标。抹镜布，打开箱子却没有"
fix_first.action: Audit and update product page descriptions, specifications, and box contents to match actual manufacturer inclusions.

keep_doing: Maintain the high price-to-performance ratio that appeals to budget-conscious and student buyers.
Continue utilizing secure double-boxing and reliable packaging to protect hardware during transit.

洗发水.name: Shampoos
洗发水.summary: Customers like the affordable pricing, fast delivery, and convenient travel bundles across various shampoo brands in the category. The main problems are product quality issues causing dandruff or itching, and frequent customer suspicions regarding authenticity and packaging leaks.

fix_first.issue: Product quality causing scalp irritation and widespread authenticity concerns
fix_first.action: Audit supplier batches and formula consistency for items flagged as counterfeit or irritating.

fix_first.issue: Packaging leaks and broken pumps during transit
fix_first.evidence: 22 negative mentions + "压泵的嘴都压断了"
fix_first.action: Improve secondary packaging and bottle cap secureness for liquid items.

fix_first.issue: Missing promotional gifts and inaccurate listing details
fix_first.evidence: 6 negative mentions + "广告欺诈 吹风机为什么不送"
fix_first.action: Align promotional descriptions with actual bundle inventory in stock.

keep_doing: Competitive pricing compared to physical supermarkets

平板.name: Tablets
平板.summary: Customers appreciate the affordable price, clear screens, and fast performance across various models in the category. However, the main problems are missing promotional freebies, poor customer service, and inconsistent listing accuracy.

fix_first.evidence: 18 negative mentions + "显示赠送钢化膜的，结果什么都没送"
fix_first.action: Audit current promotional bundle listings and ensure warehouse packing matches advertised freebies.
Retrain support agents on return procedures and issue resolution workflows to reduce customer friction.

fix_first.evidence: 6 negative mentions + "拍的时候明明是在m3"
fix_first.action: Review product detail pages to ensure specifications and model descriptions match the physical items shipped.

keep_doing: Highlight the high price-to-value ratio and affordable pricing in marketing campaigns.
Promote positive feedback regarding fast operational speed and clear display screens.

水果.name: Fruit
水果.summary: Customers appreciate the fast delivery, beautiful packaging, and fresh taste of certain items in the category, but the main problem is the poor freshness and quality with many bruised, small, or spoiled apples received.

fix_first.issue: Poor freshness and quality, with bruised or rotten apples
fix_first.evidence: 37 negative mentions + "苹果基本都是次品一个个歪瓜裂枣样"
fix_first.action: Implement stricter pre-shipment quality checks to screen out bruised and rotten fruit.

fix_first.issue: Apples are significantly smaller and below weight expectations
fix_first.evidence: 34 negative mentions + "苹果好小，估计没有2kg吧"
fix_first.action: Audit supplier sorting standards to ensure accurate sizing and net weight.
Update product images and descriptions to accurately reflect the actual appearance of the fruit.

keep_doing: Maintain the fast and reliable delivery service provided by logistics.
Keep using sturdy and appealing packaging for products that arrive undamaged.

衣服.name: Clothing
衣服.summary: Customers like the comfortable fabrics, stylish designs, and fast delivery speeds for many items. However, the main problems include incorrect product descriptions such as wrong sizing and missing features, poor customer service during exchanges, and fabric issues like severe fading and pilling.

fix_first.issue: Listing inaccuracy and wrong item variants sent
fix_first.evidence: 21 negative mentions + "商品介绍是秋冬加绒的，发货是夏天的"
fix_first.action: Audit product descriptions and inventory variant mapping to ensure items sent match the listing details.

fix_first.issue: Poor customer service and unhelpful exchange policies
fix_first.evidence: 7 negative mentions + "找客服却有很多理由搪塞我"
fix_first.action: Retrain customer support agents on exchange procedures and empower them to resolve return requests without giving excuses.

fix_first.issue: Fabric quality issues including fading and poor material
fix_first.evidence: 25 negative mentions + "掉颜色掉的那么厉害"
fix_first.action: Review textile suppliers and enforce stricter quality control on dyeing and fabric durability.

keep_doing: Highlight the comfortable and soft fabrics in product descriptions and marketing ads
Maintain the fast shipping and delivery speeds appreciated by many buyers

手机.name: Phones
手机.summary: Customers appreciate the attractive appearance, screen display, and camera quality of various models in the category. However, the main problem is poor performance and system stability, with frequent crashes, freezing, and hardware issues.

fix_first.issue: Performance and system stability issues including freezing and crashes
fix_first.evidence: 52 negative mentions + "经常死机。更要命的是用到一年多的时候，出现自动关机"
fix_first.action: Investigate software bugs and system stability across models to issue firmware updates.

fix_first.issue: After-sales support and missing original accessories
fix_first.evidence: 12 negative mentions + "原装配件中既无USB数据线，也无耳机！"
fix_first.action: Audit packaging and supplier contents to ensure all original accessories are included.

fix_first.issue: Battery life falling short of expectations
fix_first.evidence: 21 negative mentions + "与他们宣称的250小时相差甚远"
fix_first.action: Review battery specs and update marketing descriptions to reflect realistic standby times.

keep_doing: Highlight the stylish appearance and build quality in listings and ads
Promote the clear screen display and good camera features
